title: Cerrar G2 -> G3 mediante ledger validado y source builder replayable
mission: Exercise the hardened recursive Planner path end-to-end: construct a valid prometeo.integration-disposition-ledger/v1 from immutable G1 RETURN bytes, use scripts/build-planner-source-from-ledger.mjs to reproduce the G2 compiler source without manual task wording, run the same Planner compiler, execute the emitted G2 VERIFY candidate, consume its terminal RETURN through the same validated-ledger adapter, and emit G3 deterministically. Fail closed on hash/disposition/authority errors and do not promote product authority.
definition_of_done: G1 immutable RETURN bytes are SHA-256 pinned in a valid hardened disposition ledger and validated before source emission.
The new adapter deterministically emits a compiler source whose planning atom/dependency semantics reproduce the existing G2 route without hand-authored task wording.
The same persisted compile-planner-generation.mjs bytes emit the expected G2 VERIFY fingerprint/opportunity.
The emitted G2 VERIFY executes a bounded claim/run/return lifecycle as candidate evidence.
A second hardened ledger consumes the G2 terminal RETURN and the same adapter + compiler emits a G3 output/queue deterministically.
Missing/tampered RETURN bytes, self-consumption, missing/conflicted disposition, or forbidden authority fail closed.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
